annotations.text:
Widget mode — pick one.
All four fit 260×230 and use the existing meter contract: fill carries severity, unfilled track is a lighter step of the same blue ramp, and the severity word sits beside the colour so state never rests on hue alone.
Shown at Session 82% so the warning treatment is visible.

DECIDED — throughput is summarised, not sampled.
Each point is the average output tokens/sec over one interval (default 3 min, selectable 1/3/5/10/15). The app diffs cumulative output tokens between refreshes and closes a bucket when the interval elapses, so there is no second clock and no per-second work — the sampler concern is gone.
Still true: the trace only sees CLI sessions, the same blind spot as the daily chart, so a VS Code or desktop-app response reads as 0 tok/s.
Widget mode (Option A) carries no throughput trace — it stays at ~12 MB by not parsing transcripts at all.
